q: 我___球衣洗干净了。
en: I washed the jersey clean.

q: 他生气地把网球拍摔___了。
en: Angrily, he smashed his tennis racket and broke it.

q: 请把比赛的时间记___，别忘了。
en: Please remember the match time, and do not forget it.

q: 教练终于把队员们的错误动作都纠正___了。
en: The coach finally got all the players' wrong movements corrected.

q: 请把包里的球拍拿___来。
en: Please take the racket out of the bag.

q: 外面下雨了，快把自行车推___去吧。
en: It is raining outside, quick, push the bike inside.

q: 比赛结束了，你把足球带___吧。
en: The match is over, take the ball back with you.

q: 裁判把黄牌从口袋里拿___，举了起来。
en: The referee took the yellow card out of his pocket and held it up.

q: 地铁站的人太多，他好不容易才把婴儿车搬___了楼梯。
en: The metro station was so crowded that he barely managed to carry the pram down the stairs.

q: 我把自行车锁___公园门口了。
en: I locked my bike at the park entrance.

q: 司机把我们送___了火车站。
en: The driver took us to the train station.

q: 教练把这份名单交___队长了。
en: The coach handed this list to the captain.

q: 他把这首英文歌翻译___了中文。
en: He translated this English song into Chinese.

q: 我们都把他___球队的灵魂。
en: We all regard him as the soul of the team.

q: 你把这瓶水喝___吧，比赛前要补水。
en: Drink up this bottle of water, you need to rehydrate before the match.

q: 他不想要了，就把那双旧球鞋扔___。
en: He did not want them any more, so he threw the old sneakers away.

q: 请把那件球衣试___，看合不合适。
en: Please try that jersey on and see whether it fits.

q: 他把今天有比赛的事忘___，所以没带球鞋。
en: He forgot that there was a match today, so he did not bring his sneakers.

q: 我___把球拍带来，今天不能打球了。
en: I did not bring my racket, so I cannot play today.

q: 打球的时候，___把手机放在场边。
en: Do not leave your phone at the side of the court while you play.

q: 你___把地图带上，免得迷路。
en: You had better take the map with you so you do not get lost.

q: 地铁里人很多，请___把大背包放在地上。
en: The metro is crowded, so please do not put your big backpack on the floor.

q: 我把___买回来了，你明天就能用。
en: I have bought back the new basketball you wanted, so you can use it tomorrow.

q: 他很喜欢___这个城市的夜景。
en: He really likes the night view of this city.

q: 昨天我没把球鞋带回家___。
